what: Verizon is one of the largest US wireless carriers and also sells home internet (Fios fibre and fixed wireless) and network services to businesses.
customers: US consumers, businesses and government agencies.
money: mobile plans, phones and home internet
wireless and network services for companies and the public sector
moat: A nationwide network and spectrum that cost hundreds of billions to build, and a large base of monthly subscribers.
opportunities: A dividend yield above 6%, the highest of the large US operators
Fibre and fixed wireless broadband add customers without building new mobile networks
Buying Frontier extends its fibre footprint substantially
watch: Postpaid phone net additions and broadband subscriber growth.
